name: Redridge Goulash
objectiveText: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat , five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat . Great Goretusk Snout  ( 5 ) Tough Condor Meat  ( 5 ) Crisp Spider Meat  ( 5 )

comments.body:
spyders: 19,73
great gorethusk: 18,56 & 34,71
condors: 56,75
replies: finally just basic coords thank you!

comments.body:
I think I've done this quest 3-4 times between different characters. The hardest part was always the condor meat. This last time I figured out an easier way.

For some reason the condors on south part of the lake don't drop the meat nearly as often as the ones north east of town. The area I am talking about is the area over looking the wood mill where all the spiders are. There are usually only 2-3 at the most up there, and they don't respawn quickly.

While doing the quest, I would kill the condors in this area, get 1 or 2 meats. Then go pick up a few snouts from west of the lake, near the gaveyard. Then come back when the condors are respawned.
replies: Yes, the drop rate is horrible, sadistic, especially if someone else is doing the same quest in the area.

comments.body:
Althers Mill is a good place. Here you can find a lot of condors and spiders. Oh im Warrior i did this quest at level 19 easy.

Recomended  9/10
Yes, this quest will make you poke your eyes out. The Tough Condor Meat drop rate seems *rediculously* low.. I've killed about 20-25 and still have not gotten one. >.<
replies: There's also the fact that the level when you get this quest has you facing level 18-20 Dire Condors which are the only non-AH source of the Tough Condor Meat. Not fun if you're not an ezmode pet class.

comments.body:
Level 21 Dwarf Preist kill over 40 condors not a single drop of the meat... at the place where there is a lot of spider and the logging shed is.

Switch to my alt, a level 25 Human Preist... decide to give up on the above location and try the southern road... got 5 condor meat after killing about 15 condors..

There is a conspiracy against Dwarf.....

comments.body: The best place I found to get this stuff all in one place is Alther's Mill.  Lots of Condors and Spiders, and the occasional Goretusk.  But no one cares about the lack of Goretusks since you can find those guys in abudance near the flight path.
yea had to kill about 12 to get the first 3 peices of meat. tried the tip to go north ... killed 2 and got 2 pieces of meat.

yeah i went ahead and dumped my 5 spider meats, 5 snouts, and 2 condor meats on the ground and dumped the quest.

im not really gonna do these collection quests anymore unless the reward is worth it

I've killed 1/2 dozen condors and gotten 1 piece of meat.  I'm an '18' and kinda stuck.  I can't go above the mill because the creatures up there kill me like i'm standing still.  Little trolls down below are having a field day killing me too.  I can kill the dragon welps pretty quickly but it drains a lot of my health and doesn't leave much left for me to kill the condors.  I don't think I'm ever going to finish this quest.  Grrrrrrr.......

You can get this quest from Chef Breanna. She is located just at the end of Lakshire. 
Once you have the quest uploaded in your quest log, head into Lakeridge highway. It is just a little south from the bridge. There I collected 5 conodor meat from Condors and 5 crisp spider meat from Tarantulas. Now its time to head to Lakeshire. When your there, head a little west and you will see many Great goretusk mobs and Bellygrubs. Kill them and eventually you will have 5 Great goretusk snouts. :)
The quest is quite easy, you just have to know where to search. :) 
I found all the parts in about 15-30 minutes and it was quite fun. Its worth it cause the reward is quite good, especailly for the Cooks :).
